Definition
[$k$th-Order System of Partial Differential Equations]

↗ def:kth-order-pde

1. ch1:1.1-def-3\group PDE Basics

For an unknown $\mathbf{u}:U\to \R ^m$, $\mathbf{u}=(u^1,\ldots ,u^m)$, and a given map \[ \mathbf{F} : \R ^{mn^k} \times \R ^{mn^{k-1}} \times \cdots \times \R ^{mn} \times \R ^m \times U \to \R ^m, \] a $k^{\text{th}}$-order system is \begin{equation} \mathbf{F}(D^k \mathbf{u}(x), D^{k-1}\mathbf{u}(x), \ldots , D\mathbf{u}(x), \mathbf{u}(x), x) = 0 \qquad (x \in U). \tag {2} \end{equation} The displayed system has $m$ scalar equations for the $m$ components of $\mathbf{u}$; systems with fewer or more equations are also allowed.
